scope: Public contract review for one atomic geometry-observation boundary, provenance separation, case neutrality, and evidence limits.

checks.name: atomic_boundary
checks.notes: The operation inventories primitives, features, relations, symmetry, and repetition; it does not choose a construction strategy.

checks.name: provenance_boundary
checks.notes: Outputs require observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance and retain source locators when available.

checks.name: case_neutrality
checks.notes: The contract uses geometry descriptions rather than case identifiers, named products, recorded aliases, or numeric examples.

checks.name: evidence_boundary
checks.notes: Only design intent is reviewed; no implementation, application runtime, model measurement, persistence, visual acceptance, or export is claimed.

notes: Public design-only review record for the schema-bound 0.2.0 contract; it is not a host-check, source-interpretation accuracy result, or application evidence record.
